feature_boundary: All feature_* columns use annual citations only through landmark age.
outcome_boundary: Full-history Beauty Coefficient, awakening age and peak age are outcomes only.
warnings: The binary awakening/late-peak outcomes are engineering targets, not universal Sleeping Beauty labels.
No natural Beauty Coefficient cutoff is imposed.
Papers without follow-up through landmark+horizon are censored and have blank binary outcomes.
Semantic/network predictors must later be frozen at the same landmark date to avoid future leakage.
